title: Assam: Tea workers stage protest in Tinsukia demanding land rights and wage hike

ai.summary: Tea garden workers in Assam's Tinsukia district staged a two-hour protest demanding residential land rights, higher daily wages, and action on long-pending issues affecting tea tribes community.

facts.claim: Hundreds of tea garden workers, including many women, staged a two-hour protest outside the factory gate of Baghjan Tea Estate in Assam’s Tinsukia district on Wednesday
facts.quote: Doomdooma: Hundreds of tea garden workers, including many women, staged a two-hour protest outside the factory gate of Baghjan Tea Estate in Assam’s Tinsukia district on Wednesday, demanding residential land rights, higher daily wages and action on other long-pending issues affecting the tea tribes community.

facts.claim: The protest was organised by the Baghjan–Dighaltarang sub-branch committee of the Assam Tea Tribes Students’ Association (ATTSA), along with its affiliated primary units and tea garden workers
facts.quote: The protest was organised by the Baghjan–Dighaltarang sub-branch committee of the Assam Tea Tribes Students’ Association (ATTSA), along with its affiliated primary units and tea garden workers.

facts.claim: The demonstrators urged the government to expedite the process of granting periodic land pattas for residential plots where tea workers and their families have lived for generations
facts.quote: The demonstrators urged the government to expedite the process of granting periodic land pattas for residential plots where tea workers and their families have lived for generations.

facts.claim: Addressing the gathering, Irot Tanti, president of the ATTSA Doomdooma regional committee, said the protest was intended to draw attention to the community’s longstanding demands and pressing concerns
facts.quote: Addressing the gathering, Irot Tanti, president of the ATTSA Doomdooma regional committee, said the protest was intended to draw attention to the community’s longstanding demands and pressing concerns.

facts.claim: The protesters also demanded higher wages and raised other unresolved issues affecting livelihood and welfare of tea garden workers
facts.quote: The protesters also demanded higher wages and raised other unresolved issues affecting the livelihood and welfare of tea garden workers.
